purpose: Editorial UK priority for FINDR picture browsing. Sorting only; retain all 396 cards and existing evidence/IDs.
meaning: Priority means relevant to this UK servicing workflow; not country of manufacture, exclusivity, market prevalence, product certification or approval. An unmarked card means normal sort priority, not non-UK.

groups.name: UK fire and support ranges already sourced in catalogue
groups.basis: Editorial UK priority for the named existing models; existing manufacturer product/document provenance and linked UK engineer references retained. No statement of country of manufacture, exclusivity, prevalence or blanket system approval. Legacy and marine entries remain below the curated main panel shortlist.

groups.name: Advanced UK/EN families
groups.basis: MxPro range has explicit UK case-study/catalogue evidence. Axis EN and LifeLine use retained manufacturer/UK-Ireland product documentation. The Axis AX UL entry remains normal priority.

groups.name: Kentec UK/EN and legacy families
groups.basis: Select exact existing IDs, excluding the Elite and Sigma A UL-focused document families. Taktis picture is explicitly Taktis EN; linked Taktis records include other editions, so preserve all existing edition warnings. Sigma CP and CP-A manufacturer pages explicitly state BS EN54 and UK installation references.

groups.name: Morley UK picture families
groups.basis: Existing UK-specific Honeywell pages and UK-sourced Dimension/Horizon manufacturer documentation. Do not blanket-prioritise LT-159 (KSA edition), MA-2000 or PL-1000.

groups.name: Fike UK/EN product families
groups.basis: Manufacturer CIE-A-400 document has Fike UK address, CE/UKCA and EN54 details. Manufacturer TWINFLEX page cites BS5839 applications. Related old CIE/RDU/TWINFLEX entries retain specific manual provenance. Cheetah, CyberCat, FCP, FGX and SHP PRO stay normal priority.

groups.name: FireClass documented UK engineer ranges
groups.basis: Existing original manufacturer documents and UK engineer archive supply clear UK-workflow relevance; FC600 and FC708D/FC718D remain normal priority pending variant-specific review.

groups.name: UK intruder and legacy service families
groups.basis: Exact existing family list drawn from UK manufacturer and engineer support documentation. This is a UK servicing shortlist including historical models, not a market-prevalence assertion. RISCO LightSYS Air explicitly offers UK kits; retain radio/edition distinctions in source manuals.

groups.name: Honeywell Galaxy UK families
groups.basis: Honeywell GB manufacturer product pages. Keep VISTA and LYNX normal priority.

groups.name: Ajax explicitly verified UK support models
groups.basis: Manufacturer manuals expressly document PD 6662 UK setup. Other Ajax entries remain normal priority for this conservative first pass, rather than inheriting a blanket brand classification.

groups.name: UK warden-call and access support families
groups.basis: Existing models have UK manufacturer product/support pages or UK engineer documentation. Paxton10 Video remains in its existing CCTV category.

groups.name: UK-sourced recorder support families
groups.basis: Retained exact model families use en-gb manufacturer documents (Comelit) or the UK engineer archive (legacy Hikvision, Samsung, Dedicated Micros). These are international products with UK-workflow sources, not UK manufacture. Dahua general global families remain normal priority pending UK variant review.
